data.name: Elbertina
data.long_meaning: Elbertina is a Latin name composed of two parts. Elber means 'elf-bright'. Tina is derived from the Latin word 'tener' meaning 'tender, kind'. Together, Elbertina can be interpreted as 'Elf-bright and Tender, Kind'. In Christian spirituality, the name Elbertina can symbolize the light of God illuminating the tender and kind aspects of a person's soul.
